authority: Author requested an audit of Manufactured stock, revisions to names/descriptions, and proposals rather than deletion for nonqualifying items.
criterion: A retained stock entry identifies a tangible selected, processed or shaped material form that is prepared for further fabrication. It may be a powder, feed grade, billet, blank, sheet, strip, length or unfitted composite. A name alone does not establish craft readiness, a production recipe or service performance. Unqualified byproducts, finished animal feed, recovered discrete parts and redundant umbrella entries require separate review.
scope: Local catalog editorial iteration. Preserve item IDs, categories, tiers, quantities, recipe topology, review/art choices and Unity source definitions. Proposed descriptions do not install mechanics or establish material ratings. World identity, streaming/unload/reload, generated-object identity, authored placement and persisted runtime deltas are not applicable because no world/runtime content changes.

items.reason: An authored dry-sorting byproduct with Primary use still unresolved, rather than a defined fabrication stock grade. A proposed beetle-feed ingredient link alone does not establish a stock application. Preserve the existing Unity variant and dry-sort recipe until a separate decision defines relocation or removal.

items.name: Sorted Ironstone concentrate
items.description: Iron-bearing granules separated from Ironstone by the existing dry-sorting process. This concentrated mineral fraction is feed for later metal refining; it has not yet been reduced to usable iron. Its Ironstone source distinguishes it from the separately proposed selected iron-ore furnace feed.

items.reason: An authored sorting byproduct whose downstream use is unresolved. No composition or useful stock grade distinguishes it beyond particle size. It is ordinary mineral fines, not Airborne Dust. Removal requires review of its existing Unity variant and multi-output dry-sort recipe.

An authored sand-sized sorting fraction with no selected fabrication use or qualified grade. Do not invent a glassmaking composition from grain size. Removal requires review of its existing Unity variant and multi-output dry-sort recipe.

items.name: Selected iron-ore furnace feed
items.description: Iron-bearing mineral feed selected and prepared from the magnetite-rich stone or hematite routes under consideration. It is a furnace input awaiting reduction, not metal stock. Keep it distinct from the existing Ironstone concentrate only while its source preparation remains a meaningful separate design choice.

items.name: Consolidated iron bar stock
items.description: Worked iron consolidated into unfitted bars for fasteners, tool bodies and structural fittings. It is the metal-working stage after an iron bloom or selected ore has been processed, rather than another grade of loose ore. Final section, grade and forging conditions remain to be chosen.

items.name: Graded sharpening grit
items.description: Selected abrasive mineral grains sorted into a working size range for sharpening and surface preparation. The loose grit can be used in a compatible finishing process or incorporated into a bonded abrasive blank; grain composition and useful cutting behavior still require qualification.

items.name: Fired insulating ceramic blanks
items.description: Rough fired ceramic pieces reserved for later grinding into spacers, separators and supporting fittings. They are general blanks rather than fitted components. Their intended electrical-separation role does not assign a voltage, heat or chemical-service rating.

items.name: Calcined mineral binder powder
items.description: A prepared mineral powder obtained by controlled treatment of carbonate feed. It is proposed as an input to dry composite and construction-binder development; its name does not assume free water, a conventional mortar recipe or a qualified bond.

items.name: Graded graphite flake stock
items.description: Graphite-bearing feed prepared into selected flakes for dry-lubricant mixtures and conductive-material development. This is loose carbon stock, distinct from the later bonded electrode plates. Purity, flake size and the receiving formulation remain design choices.

items.reason: The generic charcoal record overlaps the retained, explicitly sourced Chitin-char entry: both proposed routes carbonize shell-derived feed. A separate tendon-based carbon grade is not yet justified. Propose removing or consolidating this umbrella row only after its ingredient links are redirected; no wood source is permitted.

items.name: Graded fired-ceramic grog
items.description: Selected broken fired ceramic crushed and graded into reusable ceramic-body aggregate. It provides a prepared granular addition to a chosen body mix, rather than an intact ceramic fitting. Composition, grain range and the mixture receiving it remain unresolved.

items.name: Blended ceramic forming feed
items.description: A measured candidate blend of prepared mineral ingredients for shaping a chosen ceramic body. It is unfired feed whose recipe must suit the intended vessel, blank or panel. This broad forming blend remains distinct from the more specific fine kaolin formulation.

items.name: Prepared ceramic glaze powder
items.description: A blended mineral finishing powder proposed for application to a compatible ceramic surface before controlled firing. It supplies an unfused surface-treatment feed, not an already glazed object. Formulation, application medium, firing conditions and contents compatibility remain open.

items.name: Carbonized husk char
items.description: Carbonized chitin-bearing husk pieces proposed as a prepared carbon input for hot-work and fuel research. The biological source distinguishes this material from wood charcoal, which the setting does not supply. Conversion conditions, usable carbon grade and behavior in the atmosphere still require design.

items.name: Unconsolidated iron bloom
items.description: A rough mass of iron-bearing metal from the proposed smelting stage, awaiting consolidation into usable working stock. It precedes the consolidated iron bars and steel-making branches. Metal yield, entrained residue and the required working process remain unqualified.

items.name: Refined copper cake
items.description: Copper gathered into a compact rough cake after the proposed first refining stage. The cake is working feed for drawing or forming conductors and small metal parts, rather than finished wire. Purity and later forming conditions remain to be established.

items.name: Reclaimed brass billet
items.description: Recovered brass selected and consolidated into an unfitted billet for later shaping. It provides a coherent working blank instead of a mixed handful of scrap. Alloy consistency, contamination and the practical reclaiming process remain unresolved.

items.name: Reclaimed bronze billet
items.description: Recovered bronze prepared as a solid working billet for strips, bearing blanks and other shaped parts. It remains bulk metal stock with no fitted interfaces. The recovered alloy must be identified before a particular forming process or service use is chosen.

items.name: Unformed opaque glass stock
items.description: Opaque glass prepared as rough solid stock for subsequent forming into sheets, linings or other glass blanks. This is the unshaped stage before the flat opaque-sheet entry. Composition, reheating conditions and usable material yield remain open.

items.name: Rough transparent glass blanks
items.description: Rough glass pieces selected for possible transparent viewing elements. They precede sized viewing blanks and ground optics, with surfaces and shape still unfinished. Transparency is a selection aim, not a guarantee of optical quality or corrective performance.

items.name: Dressed stone blocks
items.description: Stone worked into rough blocks with usable faces for later fitted construction or mounting work. Dressing supplies a manageable stock form without making every block interchangeable. Source stone, dimensions, joining method and load suitability remain to be selected.

items.name: Selected resonant stone blanks
items.description: Stone pieces selected as candidate sound-producing blanks before final shaping and acoustic matching. They provide the starting stock for tuned stone bars or instrument elements. Mineral choice, defects and useful sound response remain to be assessed.

items.name: Ground mineral pigment stock
items.description: Mineral colorant ground into a prepared powder for decorative coatings and marking mixtures. It supplies the solid pigment fraction before a compatible carrier is added. Color consistency, particle grade and application properties remain design questions.

items.name: Graded mineral filler powder
items.description: Selected mineral particles prepared as a controlled filler for candidate binders and composite mixes. The filler changes the body of a receiving formulation rather than acting as a complete adhesive itself. Grain range, composition and the intended mix remain unresolved.

items.name: Sorted glass cullet
items.description: Broken glass selected and sorted into remelt feed for a compatible glass batch. It is prepared secondary material rather than reusable intact glazing. Mixed compositions, coatings and contamination must be resolved before a batch can be treated as a useful grade.

items.name: Separated mica flake stock
items.description: Mica separated into loose flakes for composite sheets and other layered-material trials. This is particulate mineral feed before bonding, distinct from intact mica viewing sheets. Flake size, binder choice and the resulting material behavior remain open.

items.name: Prepared husk-fiber paper furnish
items.description: Scraped husk fibers cleaned and conditioned into feed ready for a proposed paper-forming process. It identifies the prepared fiber stage without assuming a water-based slurry. Sheet formation, compatible processing medium and yield remain to be designed.

items.name: Cleaned brush-bristle bundles
items.description: Faunal bristles cleaned, sorted and bundled as feed for brush strips and grit-exclusion fittings. Their useful form is a controlled set of working fibers rather than loose gathered bristles. Retention, stiffness and wear require qualification in the receiving assembly.

items.name: Separated shell lamina sheets
items.description: Thin layers separated and prepared from bulk shell husks for later lamination or shaping. These sheets are intermediate shell stock, distinct from assembled armor panels and from loose raw plates. Thickness, preparation and bonding remain unresolved.

items.name: Shaped faunal hard-part blanks
items.description: Faunal hard tissue selected and roughly shaped into solid blanks for tool edges, wear inserts or small fittings. Each blank still needs a chosen working profile and mounting. Source anatomy and useful material behavior remain subject to the existing biological limits.

items.name: Graded industrial salt feed
items.description: Mineral salts selected and graded for proposed industrial processing mixtures. This is a controlled feed grade rather than an unidentified raw salt crust. Composition and process compatibility remain unresolved, and this entry supplies no food-grade or edible-salt claim.

items.name: Rough-cut gemstone blanks
items.description: Gemstone pieces cut into rough preforms for later polishing, setting or inlay work. The cutting stage establishes a usable starting shape while leaving the final finish and fitting unfinished. Gem grade, loss during working and individual dimensions remain open.

items.name: Graded gemstone inlay chips
items.description: Small stone fragments selected by workable size for decorative inlay mixtures and fitted patterns. They are loose ornamental stock rather than finished jewelry or set panels. Color selection, setting method and compatible binding material remain undecided.

items.name: Burnished shell inlay blanks
items.description: Thin shell pieces with prepared visible faces, reserved for cutting and fitting into ornamental surfaces. They remain loose inlay stock before a pattern or receiving object is chosen. Final dimensions, retention and surface finish remain design work.

items.name: Sized mica viewing sheets
items.description: Intact mica sheets selected and cut to manageable sizes for proposed viewing openings. They retain their natural layered form instead of being reduced to flakes and rebound. Usable clarity, mounting, thickness and service conditions remain unqualified.

items.name: Composite insulation blanks
items.description: Unfitted composite blanks proposed from prepared mica layers, ceramic pieces and compatible binding material. They provide stock for later electrical separators or shaped barriers, giving the insulation family a concrete intermediate form. Composition, geometry and electrical or thermal ratings remain unresolved.

items.name: Unfitted steel stock
items.description: Steel prepared as general working stock for subsequent forming into parts, sheets and specialist grades. It is distinct from consolidated iron and from later spring-grade or finished-section steel. Exact composition, supplied section and production conditions remain to be chosen.

items.name: Graded refractory mineral powder
items.description: Selected heat-work mineral feed ground and graded before forming a refractory body. It supplies a prepared input to ceramic linings and hot-work blanks, not an already fired protective part. Composition and performance at the intended service conditions remain unqualified.

items.name: Selected manganese mineral feed
items.description: Manganese-bearing mineral material selected into a candidate refining and alloy-preparation feed. It precedes the prepared metal alloying addition, so collecting this stock does not supply alloy-ready manganese metal. Source composition and extraction remain unresolved.

items.name: Prepared manganese alloying addition
items.description: A processed metal-bearing addition prepared from the selected manganese-feed route for a proposed steel-making batch. It is a controlled alloy input rather than raw mineral feed or finished steel. Actual composition, addition rate and process compatibility remain undecided.

items.name: Drawn copper wire stock
items.description: Copper formed into continuous unfitted wire lengths for conductors, windings and later braiding or mesh work. The lengths have no terminals or installed circuit role. Wire section, purity, forming process and useful electrical loading remain to be selected.

items.name: Bronze bearing blanks
items.description: Bronze stock shaped into rough blanks intended for later boring and fitting as bearing surfaces. These are machining inputs rather than working bearings. Alloy, clearance, lubrication and the load of the receiving mechanism remain unqualified.

items.name: Fired refractory ceramic blanks
items.description: Prepared refractory feed formed and fired into rough blanks for hot-work linings and supports. This is the fired stock stage after the graded mineral powder, before a final fitting is made. Heat cycling, atmosphere and useful service limits require qualification.

items.name: Formed opaque glass sheets
items.description: Opaque glass stock formed into flat unfitted sheets for later panel, cover or lining work. The sheet form distinguishes it from the rough bulk glass feed. Thickness, cutting, edge preparation and compatibility with its eventual use remain unresolved.

items.name: Selected viewing-glass blanks
items.description: Transparent glass blanks selected and sized for an intended viewing element before optical grinding. They are a later preparation of rough transparent glass, with a useful starting shape but no final optical surface. Clarity, fit and the chosen application remain open.

items.name: Bonded husk-fiber sheets
items.description: Prepared husk-fiber material bonded into unfitted sheets for later clothing panels and other shaped work. The sheets remain difficult processed biological material rather than ordinary woven cloth. Thickness, flexibility, joining and usable yield require design.

items.name: Reinforced wing-membrane sheets
items.description: Prepared insect-wing membrane strengthened with candidate biological bindings and edge reinforcement. It is stock for later fitted sails or wind-facing panels, without the joints and supports of a complete assembly. Useful size, joining and wind loads remain unresolved.

items.name: Prepared mineral pigment coating mix
items.description: Ground mineral pigment combined with a candidate faunal carrier into a coating mixture. It is an application-ready stock concept rather than an already decorated object. Carrier chemistry, preparation, adhesion and wear remain to be established.

items.name: Bonded mica composite sheets
items.description: Separated mica flakes bonded into coherent unfitted sheets. This makes a formed composite stock distinct from both loose mica flakes and intact natural viewing sheets. Binder choice, thickness and useful insulating behavior remain unqualified.

items.name: Shaped resonant stone bars
items.description: Selected resonant-stone blanks worked into candidate bar forms for later acoustic matching and instrument fitting. Shaping is a material preparation stage; it does not supply a complete tuned instrument. Bar dimensions and useful sound response remain design work.

items.name: Polished gemstone setting blanks
items.description: Rough-cut gemstone blanks brought to a prepared visible finish for later setting or inlay. They remain loose stock without a mounting or finished jewelry form. Final dimensions, compatible setting and acceptable finish are still to be chosen.

items.name: Steel-faced shell laminate sheets
items.description: Shell laminate bonded to a prepared steel face as composite sheet stock for later protective fittings. The metal face and shell backing remain an unfitted material combination, rather than a complete guard. Bonding, shaping and protective behavior require qualification.

items.name: Spring-grade steel blanks
items.description: Steel prepared as candidate resilient blanks for later forming into springs or flexing parts. This is a proposed material grade before a particular spring geometry is chosen. Composition, heat treatment, working deflection and fatigue behavior remain unresolved.

items.name: Insulation-wrapped copper lengths
items.description: Drawn copper lengths combined with candidate mica-based and flexible insulating material. They are unfinished conductor stock awaiting cutting, termination and fitting. The wrapped form does not establish a voltage rating, weather seal or storm protection.

items.name: Ceramic-faced shell laminate panels
items.description: Prepared ceramic faces bonded to shell laminate as unfitted composite panels. The panels are material blanks for later protection or enclosure work, not finished armor. Layer geometry, bonding, impact behavior and useful service limits remain unqualified.

items.name: Ground optical glass blanks
items.description: Selected viewing-glass blanks with surfaces ground for a proposed optical element. This is prepared optical stock before a final prescription, alignment or mounting is chosen. Surface accuracy, optical behavior and useful application remain unresolved.

items.name: Layered husk-composite sheets
items.description: Multiple bonded husk sheets built into thicker composite stock for shaped structural or casing work. This layered material is distinct from the simpler single-sheet clothing feed. Binder, layer arrangement, shaping and useful strength remain to be established.

items.name: Reinforced seal-sheet stock
items.description: A candidate seal compound supported with prepared mineral and flexible binding layers as cuttable sheet stock. It awaits the outline and contact geometry of a particular joint. Chemical compatibility, compression behavior and any pressure or dust seal require qualification.

items.name: Surface-finished husk sheets
items.description: Prepared husk sheet brought to a decorative visible finish before cutting into trim or ornament. It is unfinished stock for a receiving object rather than a complete clothing or display item. Surface treatment, joining and durability remain open.

items.name: Layered protective panel blanks
items.description: Steel-faced and ceramic-faced shell materials combined into unfitted layered panel blanks. They supply a composite starting form for later guards or covers. Layer arrangement, attachment, coverage and actual protective performance remain design questions.

items.name: Encased conductor lengths
items.description: Insulation-wrapped conductor stock enclosed with candidate sealing layers and ceramic support pieces. It is supplied as unfitted lengths before terminals and equipment interfaces are added, rather than a complete wiring harness. Enclosure geometry, continuity and service qualification remain unresolved.

items.name: Husk-composite casing blanks
items.description: Layered husk-composite stock prepared with candidate seal-sheet interfaces as rough enclosure blanks. Openings, mounting points and final joints still need fitting to the intended equipment. The blank is not a finished container and carries no guaranteed dust, pressure or chemical seal.

items.name: Drawn steel tube lengths
items.description: Steel formed into unfitted hollow lengths for later joint, guide or valve-body fabrication. The tube is a prepared section rather than a complete pressure part. Bore consistency, wall geometry, cutting and the requirements of each structural or pressure application remain separate design work.

items.name: Braided copper conductor stock
items.description: Drawn copper strands braided into flexible unfitted conducting lengths. The braid can feed a later grounding lead with matched terminals, but it has no installed charge path by itself. Section, joins and grounding behavior remain unqualified; it is not insulation.

items.name: Woven copper mesh sheets
items.description: Drawn copper wire woven into unfitted open mesh sheets for later electrical-screening assemblies. The sheet still needs a chosen aperture, supporting frame and continuous fitted joints. No shielding frequency range or protection rating is established.

items.name: Polished copper reflector blanks
items.description: Copper blanks worked to a proposed reflective visible surface for later optical assemblies. They remain loose unfinished reflectors awaiting a chosen outline, support and alignment. Surface quality and useful reflection behavior require qualification.

items.name: Husk-reinforced packing lengths
items.description: Prepared husk material combined with candidate sealing compounds into lengths intended for later gland packing. The stock must be cut and fitted around a particular interface. Working movement, wear, contents compatibility and any pressure or dust exclusion remain unqualified.

items.name: Bonded wing-seam strips
items.description: Reinforced wing-membrane stock prepared as narrow strips for joining or strengthening a later sail-panel seam. It is a supply of unfitted reinforcement rather than a completed sail joint. Bonding, edge retention and the eventual wind load remain unresolved.

items.name: Flexible husk-composite strips
items.description: Bonded husk sheet prepared with a flexible candidate binder as narrow jointing strips. They provide stock for later articulated covers or composite joins without introducing ordinary cloth. Useful bending range, retention and repeated-flex behavior remain unqualified.

items.name: Abrasive-faced steel blanks
items.description: Steel blanks carrying a bonded abrasive working layer for later finishing-tool heads. They are unfinished tool-face stock before shaping and mounting. Grain grade, binder behavior, cutting action and safe operating conditions remain to be established.

items.name: Gem-inlaid metal panel blanks
items.description: Metal panels carrying prepared gemstone inlay, retained as unfitted decorative stock. They still need cutting, edge work and attachment to a chosen object. Pattern, setting method and durability remain proposals, with no gemstone power or assigned cultural meaning.

items.name: Bonded glass-ceramic lining panels
items.description: Prepared glass and ceramic layers bonded into unfitted lining panels for a later vessel insert. They are lining stock rather than a ready chemical container. Contents compatibility, joints, support and thermal behavior must be selected for the receiving vessel.

items.name: Pressed mineral-husk barrier boards
items.description: Layered husk, mica and candidate sealing materials pressed into unfitted barrier boards. The boards provide stock for later enclosure separators or insulating panels. Layer construction, machining and electrical, thermal or fire performance remain unqualified.

items.name: Layered inlay veneer sheets
items.description: Decorative husk material and gem-inlaid panel stock combined into thin composite trim sheets. The material awaits cutting and mounting on a chosen display, civic object or dress fitting. Manufacture, layer thickness and attachment remain proposals without a fixed cultural association.

items.name: Assay-selected Iron Growth feed
items.description: Iron Growth pieces grouped into a composition-identified working lot before alloy preparation. Selection gives the feed a defined processing purpose without turning source age or depth into a material tier. Sampling, acceptance limits and available analytical tools remain unresolved.

items.name: Worked Growth-alloy blanks
items.description: Prepared Iron Growth feed proposed as worked alloy blanks for later canister-related fittings and other selected parts. The blank form avoids claiming a certified canister grade. Composition, additives, forming process and service compatibility still require qualification.

items.name: Conditioned faunal reinforcement fibers
items.description: Harvested electroactive-fiber material dried and prepared as passive reinforcing bundles for candidate composites. It is a material input rather than a preserved biological actuator. Preparation, bonding and useful reinforcing behavior remain unresolved, with no retained motion or electrical activity assumed.

items.reason: A prepared domestic-beetle ration is an animal-husbandry consumable, not stock awaiting equipment or material fabrication. Its species suitability also remains unverified. Propose removing it from this stock register; retain elsewhere only if the author wants the feeding concept, with its recipe dependencies reviewed first.

items.name: Drawn iron wire stock
items.description: Selected iron prepared as unfitted conductor wire for bulky electrical assemblies. It is a separate metal feed from the copper-wire branch and still needs a chosen section and connections. Current capacity, losses, protection and service behavior remain unqualified.

items.name: Unheaded iron rivet blanks
items.description: Short iron blanks prepared as feed for later rivet forming and fitting. They are unfinished fastener stock before the final head, length and joint are chosen. Grade, forming method and the receiving assembly’s requirements remain open.

items.name: Selected nickel-bearing alloy feed
items.description: Nickel-bearing mineral material sorted into a selected refining feed for possible alloy production. It remains mineral stock rather than pure nickel or an alloy-ready metal addition. Composition, extraction and the alloy application still require design.

items.name: Selected tin-bearing smelter feed
items.description: Tin-bearing mineral material prepared as a selected smelting feed for the proposed bronze branch. The feed is distinct from tin metal and from an already combined bronze billet. Mineral grade, recovery and batch composition remain unresolved.

items.name: Fine kaolin ceramic-body mix
items.description: A selected fine kaolin-based forming mixture proposed for ceramic work that needs a more specific feed than the broad blended body entry. It is unfired prepared material awaiting a chosen shape and firing process. Composition, preparation and useful product properties remain open.

items.name: Graded magnesite refractory feed
items.description: Magnesite-bearing mineral material prepared as a graded feed for candidate refractory bodies. Its selected mineral branch distinguishes it from the broader refractory-powder entry. Composition, forming method and high-temperature service remain unqualified.

items.name: Worked bronze strip stock
items.description: Bronze billet stock formed into long flat strips for later contact pieces, decorative fittings or other shaped metal parts. It is distinct from thicker bearing blanks and the later thin-foil form. Alloy, thickness and any resilient or electrical service must be chosen for the application.

items.name: Annealed iron sheet stock
items.description: Worked iron formed and annealed as unfitted sheet for housings, utensils and instrument bodies. It supplies a flat metal working form rather than a finished cover or vessel. Thickness, forming sequence and final material behavior remain to be established.

items.name: Pressed shell-mineral friction blanks
items.description: Shell lamina, selected mineral filler and candidate binder pressed into rough working blanks for later friction surfaces. They are material stock before fitting to a brake or clutch. Friction behavior, wear, heat response and mounting remain unqualified.

items.reason: These are recovered magnet fragments selected for surviving magnetism, not a newly manufactured material or standardized stock form. They fit the recovered Salvage lane more directly. Propose removing this row from the manufactured-stock register or retaining it as a qualified salvage variant after checking its dependent routes.

items.name: Pressed hide fastening strips
items.description: Scarce processed hide pressed and cut into unfitted fastening strips for later garment ties and retainers. The strips remain a supply of flexible material before particular fittings are made. Joining, dimensions and usable strength require design, and the very low hide yield remains in force.

items.name: Fine steel music-wire stock
items.description: Spring-grade steel drawn into fine unfitted wire for later instrument strings and other selected tensioned parts. This is prepared stock before a working length, mounting and tuning are chosen. Wire grade, working tension and acoustic behavior remain unqualified.

items.name: Bonded graphite electrode blanks
items.description: Selected graphite flakes bonded into rough plate blanks for later electrode shaping and fitting. They are a formed carbon material rather than a complete cell or battery. Composition, connections, chemical compatibility and useful electrical service remain unresolved.

items.name: Punched iron screen stock
items.description: Worked iron sheet punched with a repeating pattern of openings before final cutting and mounting. It supplies stock for ventilation faces, sorting screens or equipment covers. Hole geometry and service fit remain to be chosen; the sheet is not a finished or rated filter.

items.name: Flanged iron channel lengths
items.description: Worked iron formed into shallow channel lengths with outward lips for later mounting and joining. The unfitted sections can supply candidate frame members or casing supports. Cutting, joint geometry and useful loading remain to be designed.

items.name: Corrugated steel sheet stock
items.description: Prepared steel sheet formed into parallel ridges before cutting into covers or wind-facing panels. The corrugated section gives this stock a distinct forming stage from plain steel sheet. Thickness, joining, forming conditions and useful stiffness remain unqualified.

items.name: Fired ceramic tube lengths
items.description: Rough fired ceramic tube lengths awaiting cutting, grinding and matching to a selected guide, spacer or passage. They are unfitted hollow stock rather than a complete insulated or chemical-service fitting. Bore finish, fragility and all service ratings remain unresolved.

items.name: Rough-fired ceramic ring blanks
items.description: Ceramic rings formed and fired as unfinished stock for later collars, spacers or other matched parts. Their inner and outer surfaces still need grinding and fitting to a chosen assembly. No precise dimension, electrical rating or installed component function is assigned.

items.name: Laminated mica shim strips
items.description: Layered mica-composite stock prepared as thin strips for later gap adjustment and separation of fitted surfaces. These are uncut shim blanks rather than a matched spacer set. Thickness selection, binder behavior and useful insulating performance require qualification.

items.name: Fine-bore copper tube stock
items.description: Copper formed into narrow-bore unfitted tubing for later instrument passages or controlled transfer of compatible contained substances. It is distinct from solid copper wire. Bore consistency, cleaning, fittings and material compatibility remain open, with no water system or flow rating implied.

items.name: Hammered bronze foil stock
items.description: Bronze strip or billet feed worked into very thin unfitted sheets for later cladding, labels and selected metal layers. The foil form distinguishes it from the thicker bronze strips. Thickness control, joining and durability remain to be established.
